_about: Items deferred while porting the Ender IO 8.2.x subset onto 6.2.x, per bundle, and what the release left open. Later porters: grep this file for your bundle or feature id and pick up what was handed to you. Paths under bp2/ are in the workflow scratchpad and are not in the repo.

eio-b1-6x-fix-pack: eio-b1-6x-fix-pack / all ids: in-game tests on a world copy were not run (tank recipes with a nearly full tank, sponge and wet sponge swap, mending with an occupied output, charging stacked capacitor banks, ghost slots with Inventory Sorter, a SAG mill with two outputs stalled, the powered spawner rebind keeping its capacitor, ME conduits reloading next to an AE2 controller). No headless client was available.
eio-b1-6x-fix-pack / network-packet-hardening: the forged C2SDataSlotChange and C2SSetConduitExtendedData test from 100 blocks away was not run (needs a modified client).
eio-b1-6x-fix-pack / small-fixes: the EntityFilterSlot crash fix was not reproduced or tested on a production dedicated server. Evidence is a javac verifier test plus reading the bytecode.

follow-up audit, not in any bundle: other common-code classes import net.minecraft.client (for example ObeliskBlockEntity, FluidTankItem, CoordinateSelectorItem, PlayerMovementHandler, DarkSteelLadderHandler, S2CDataSlotUpdate). Not checked for the verifier crash pattern. Most are guarded or client-only paths. Checked on 2026-11-06: CoordinateSelectorItem ran instanceof LocalPlayer on the server and is fixed in b915fdd (from 95ca40bac). ObeliskBlockEntity (only in clientTick), FluidTankItem (initializeClient), PlayerMovementHandler (behind isClientSide), DarkSteelLadderHandler (a Dist.CLIENT subscriber), S2CDataSlotUpdate and ServerToClientLightUpdateHandler (client packet handlers) reach client classes only on the client. Read, not run on a production dedicated server.

pre-existing, left as is: the server-side IO config data slot callback does nothing on the server (no capability invalidation or neighbour update after a GUI change), ChemicalConduitData never sends its GUI reset (default serializeGuiNBT), and SagMillingRecipe.craft can merge stacks past 64.

eio-b1-6x-fix-pack / handoff (integrator): the rules for later bundles (addClientDataSlot with a validating setter for every GUI-changed slot, getMaxRange override on every obelisk, new conduit GUI fields in both serializeGuiNBT and applyGuiNBT, filters and facades only through menu slots, Packet.canAccessBlock = loaded + player.canReach(pos, 1.5) since c6a76d2, copies in the snapshot output check, TravelAnchorBlockEntity.MAX_NAME_LENGTH 50, CapacitorUtil.getRandomModifier(RandomSource, Collection)) are in the COMMON RULES of the eio-b0-fork-bootstrap spec in ports/enderio-backport-inventory.json (343565b). Later bundles compile with compileJava compileMachinesJava compileConduitsJava compileArmoryJava and LC_ALL=C.UTF-8.

Not tried: a charger in a real client, and the selector on the production Arclight jar.
eio-b2-vat: eio-b2-vat / vat-machine: no in-game client test was possible (no headless client). Untested: the screen layout, the dump and move buttons sent through real packets, JEI and EMI showing all nine recipes, the JEI + transfer, two players in one Vat menu, and the synced data map values in the screen and JEI. The b0 open item 'a real client join that shows the synced values' remains open.

eio-b2-vat / vat-fermenting-recipes: ELM's Killer Joe actually burning Vat nutrient distillation was not run. The dev environment cannot load the production ELM jar. The evidence is the matching fluid id enderio:nutrient_distillation and eiocompat 0 missing.
eio-b2-vat / vat-machine: forged VatMoveTankPacket or VatDumpTankPacket from out of reach, or without the menu open, were not sent (needs a modified client).

follow-up, not in any bundle: the 6.x MachineFluidHandler.drain(int) always drains tank 0. Its `!= FluidStack.EMPTY` check never fails, because MachineFluidTank.drain(int) returns a new stack, and it has no canExtract check. Only the Vat overrides it. The soul binder's insert-only XP tank can still be pulled through drain(int) by external pipes. The machine lane (b3, b4, b8) should keep this in mind for any multi-tank machine.

eio-b2-vat / integration note for the ship stage: runData writes src/generated/resources/.cache (git ignores it), and processResources then packs that .cache folder into the -all jar, because build.gradle excludes nothing. Delete src/generated/resources/.cache after runData, or exclude it, before the release build. The b2 integration jar 9594b5708d5dbd5779a64de42bb98b5bbcb4ad79 was built without it.

eio-b4-charger-keybinds / integrator: optional review notes left as they are. A blocked blink (Inhibitor Obelisk, or a Bukkit plugin that cancels the teleport on Arclight) still pays 1000 energy and the cooldown, because TravelHandler.shortTeleport returns true once a target exists, as a crouching staff use and upstream 8.x do (documented on the okf page). The anchor RequestTravelPacket item path still reads blocks at anchors up to itemToBlockRange (192) away, which can load their chunks, because a level.isLoaded guard would refuse legitimate jumps past the server view distance (only the isAlive guard was added). Holding the travel key shows the anchors even without a usable staff (cosmetic, as upstream 565ef4c3e). Once a fork build ships, bump PROTOCOL_VERSION in every later build whose packet list differs.

The integration ran headless dev checks instead (66 of 66 passed, scratchpad/bp2/enderio/b5int/runserver-int.log): big, limited, damage mode and basic filters in item conduits, limited stock levels on insert and extract, and limited and basic filters in the vacuum chest. Resolved at integration in 1a3a27b, kept for the record: FluidFilter.use and EntityFilter.use (and RedstoneFilterItem.use) opened the menu from the off hand, while the menu reads the main hand, so an unrelated main hand item threw in the menu constructor and logged a FATAL line through the server task executor. All filter items now open their menu only from the main hand, checked headless for five filter kinds.

Follow-up, not in any bundle (perf, review note): ItemFilterCapability.test and LimitedItemFilterCapability deserialize every entry with ItemStack.of on each call, which posts AttachCapabilitiesEvent per entry. The 36-slot big filters cost 3.6 times the advanced filter, and getTransferLimit runs findMatch again after test. A cache of the parsed entries on the capability instance, invalidated in setEntry and keyed on the ItemEntries ListTag identity, would cut that on busy conduit networks. Not a correctness problem.

eio-b7-conduit-facades / integrator: the review fix 866d7a0 covers the review's must fix (enlightened fused quartz and clear glass facades now give light 15 through the position aware getLightEmission asked against EmptyBlockGetter) and two faults that the integrator's dev client run found: a client inside the view distance never got the light of a facade placed on or taken off an existing bundle, because the 1.20.1 server sends a light change alone only to players at the view distance edge (ChunkHolder.broadcastChanges, getPlayers boundaryOnly true), so the client block entity now runs checkBlock when the synced facade state changes, and the hit particles of a faced bundle were tinted with the conduit channel colour of tint index 0 (dark green), so ConduitBlockClientExtensions.addHitEffects now spawns them with the facade's own state. It also adds canEntityDestroy false for hardened facades (wither, wither skulls, ender dragon) and the null guard of FacadeItemModel.getTransforms. This supersedes the porter items about the missing client test and the hardened tooltip in part: the mining time stays 1.5 and a basic facade is still lost to explosions.

eio-b9-visual-polish handoff: landing and running particles of a faced bundle still come from vanilla with the bundle state, so they show the facade sprite tinted with the conduit channel colour of tint index 0 (dark green). The port of 6ae3dd177 should spawn them with the facade state, as upstream's ConduitBundleBlock.addLandingEffects and addRunningEffects do. IClientBlockExtensions.areBreakingParticlesTinted does not exist in Forge 47.1.1, the fork's compile target, so it cannot be used. Facade break particles reach only the breaking player, because ConduitBlock.onDestroyedByPlayer and handleShiftYeta call Level.addDestroyBlockEffect, a no op on the server. level.levelEvent(player, 2001, pos, Block.getId(facadeState)) would also show them, with the sound, to the other players, as Block.spawnDestroyParticles does.

eio-b7-conduit-facades / integrator: review notes left as they are. A faced bundle has a full collision shape, so it is a redstone conductor (shouldCheckWeakPower), mobs can spawn on top and pathing treats it as solid, as in 8.x. This only changes 6.x setups once someone covers them, because 6.x never wrote facades (documented on the okf page). #enderio:hide_facades keeps the wrench and the probe only. The bundle keeps noOcclusion and does not delegate getLightBlock, as upstream, so a dark fused quartz facade does not block light and solid facades do not cull neighbour faces. The okf record of the done facades and the inventory status line are in 3059449. UPSTREAM.md and NOTICE still carry no list of backported features, as for every bundle so far, and no sound or third party code was added, so NOTICE needs no new attribution.

release / test finding, not fixed: a /setblock, /clone or /data merge of an enderio:conduit with a ConduitBundle compound leaves the bundle without graph nodes, because ConduitBlockEntity.load reads the types after setLevel ran loadFromSavedData. The next capability query of a neighbour crashes the server tick (ConduitBundle.getNodeFor: no node matching original type), and the bundle cannot be saved. 6.2.18-beta and the release jar 6.3.0-skytekx.1 both do this on the savegame test server (workflow scratchpad, eioship/sg/old-console-crashedtry.log and new4-console.log). Bundles that load with their chunk get their nodes. Not verified: whether moving a bundle with a Create contraption, which also loads the block entity after placing it, takes the same path. A fix would create the missing nodes in load or onLoad.

release / fix build (4980259, SHA-1 a05d8b0aec3e8429e74ebd0b754c2c04f139ca10): the jar of df80207 lacked the wired charger fix of aa5d911b0. The new jar adds it (92dc525) and the coordinate selector fix (b915fdd) and names both in NOTICE_enderio. Against the jar of df80207 only those three entries differ. The same open items as above apply, and nobody has charged an item in a wired charger in a real client.

release / test finding, not fixed: without Starlight, MachineBlock.getLightEmission (MachineBlock.java:151-168, code of the base) reads the block entity through getExistingBlockEntity on a light worker, which waits for the main thread. The first dev self test deadlocked that way at its stop, the main thread waiting for the light (bp2/enderio/fix/runserver-after1-deadlock.log, jstack in the session). The pack server runs Starlight 1.1.2, so it takes the safe getBlockEntity branch. A single player world of the pack has no Starlight (client env unsupported) and Create's Flywheel only changes the branch for its visualization level, so single player may meet the deadlock. Not verified in a client.
